title: Chapter 4: the cube moves mid-reach
judge_reason: the cube rests in the target zone and the gripper has released it
agent_summary: The red cube is resting in the green target zone, 3.4 mm from its centre, and the gripper is open and clear of it; check_task confirmed success. The first grasp at the tracker's reported position [0.50, 0.00] closed on nothing, because the cube had moved to about [0.50, 0.15] without the arm touching it. The tracker and the top camera agreed on the new position, so I lifted, re-planned and grasped there (holding = true, 0.04 m opening). Transport, placing and retreat all reached their targets with errors under 1 mm, and the front camera image shows the cube in the zone.
